System

Accounts, login and environment selection

The player selects Development or the configured production realm, authenticates, then receives a character list belonging to that verified account. Login establishes identity, not permission to invent inventory or spawn a pawn.

Scope and player interaction

The player selects Development or the configured production realm, authenticates, then receives a character list belonging to that verified account. Login establishes identity, not permission to invent inventory or spawn a pawn.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase04committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

EnvironmentSelection → SignedOut → Authenticating → CharacterList → RecoverableError → Maintenance

WBP_Login observes results from URPGAccountSession. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Environment_Development. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
EnvironmentId: stable allowlisted ID; never an arbitrary client-provided backend URL
AccountId: backend UUID mapped from provider subject; read only on client
AccessToken: transient memory only; never a log, SaveGame or content asset
TokenExpiryUtc: provider/server timestamp; refresh through provider flow
BuildProtocolVersion and ContentCatalogHash: exact server compatibility checks

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGAccountSessionImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_LoginLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
BeginLogin(EnvironmentId, ProviderChoice) -> Pending|EnvironmentUnavailable; client adapter, asynchronous
CompleteIdentityExchange(ProviderProof, Nonce) -> AccountSession|Unauthorized; backend proposal
ListCharacters() -> CharacterSummary[]|SessionExpired; backend-authorized read
SignOut() -> Cleared; local credentials discarded and server session release requested

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Choose DA_Environment_Development from a fixed menu; disable any public-connect option in development-auth mode.
  2. URPGAccountSession obtains a provider proof or loopback-only fixture token; the backend validates issuer, audience, expiry and nonce and maps the subject to AccountId.
  3. Backend returns a short-lived app session and immutable character summaries; it does not accept an AccountId supplied as authority by the UI.
  4. WBP_Login leaves Authenticating only on the matching request generation; responses from a previously selected environment are ignored.
  5. WBP_CharacterSelect receives the new list and version. A server admission ticket is requested only after the player selects an owned character.
  6. On expiry, clear or refresh the app session and reconnect from durable state; never reuse an old zone session epoch.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create L_FrontEnd as an empty level with BP_MenuGameMode and no gameplay pawn. Put a neutral 3D preview floor and preview camera in a separate preview actor.
  2. Create DA_Environment_Development with an allowlisted loopback API origin, display text key and ProtocolVersion=1. Keep credentials out of it.
  3. In BP_RPGPlayerController, create WBP_MainMenu for local controllers only; Login opens WBP_Login, passing the single process-local URPGAccountSession adapter.
  4. Bind LoginButton.OnClicked to BeginLogin and disable the button until that request settles. Bind cancel to a generation increment rather than trying to undo a completed backend login.
  5. Use two fixture identities on a private development network. Production startup must refuse the fixture authenticator even when a client passes its option.

Reopen Phase04 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_FrontEnd / service fixture Account_A and Account_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Expired proof -> Unauthorized; remain SignedOut, with no character summaries leaked.
Switch environment while request is outstanding -> old reply ignored; no mixed realm characters.
Select another account's CharacterId -> Forbidden; no zone reservation.
Backend unavailable -> EnvironmentUnavailable; retry has no inventory/character writes.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed app-token lifetime 15 minutes and explicit refresh; provider limits take precedence. No real password store is implemented by this documentation.

Log correlation ID, environment, provider result code and latency, never credentials or raw identity proofs. Screen reader status text announces pending, failed and signed-in states.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
